title: Dhakaiya Dripz 320 GSM Acid Wash Drop-Shoulder Tee
tagline: Heavy combed cotton vintage mineral wash silhouette.
description: Crafted from ultra-heavyweight 320 GSM 100% combed cotton, this drop-shoulder boxy tee features an authentic acid mineral wash treatment. Engineered with a tight ribbed collar and reinforced flatlock stitching for the ultimate oversized streetwear drape.

title: Dhakaiya Dripz Tactical Bungee Parachute Cargo Pants
tagline: Architectural parachute silhouette with adjustable ankle toggles.
description: Engineered from high-density tactical nylon ripstop, these wide-leg parachute pants feature articulated knee darts, dual gusseted 3D cargo pockets, and bungee cord cinch stoppers at both the waist and hems for an instantly adjustable silhouette.
details: Dual 3D bellows cargo utility pockets with storm flaps
Concealed bungee cord hem cinch stoppers
Articulated knee pleats for ergonomic movement

title: Dhakaiya Dripz Heavyweight 480 GSM Boxy Hooded Sweatshirt
tagline: Ultra-dense double-faced French terry with seamless hood drape.
description: Built with custom 480 GSM double-faced diagonal loop French terry, this hoodie delivers an imposing boxy drape with zero shoulder seams, double-lined crossover hood, hidden side seam pockets, and heavyweight 2x2 ribbed hems.
details: 480 GSM heavy diagonal loop French terry

title: Dhakaiya Dripz Relaxed Pleated Wide-Leg Twill Trousers
tagline: Tailored streetwear hybrid in heavy garment-dyed cotton twill.
description: Merging Savile Row tailoring with contemporary Dhaka streetwear culture. Features double front knife pleats, a wide fluid drape through the leg, welt back pockets, and an internal drawstring waist hidden inside a structured waistband.
details: Double forward knife pleats for fluid drape
Concealed YKK metal zip fly and horn button closure
Dual side slant pockets and rear welt pockets
Straight wide-leg cut designed for stacked sneakers

title: Dhakaiya Dripz Raw-Hem Drop-Shoulder Heavy Tee
tagline: Deconstructed distressed finish in 280 GSM single jersey.
description: Designed with an edgy raw-cut deconstructed hemline and subtle distressed edge grinding. Made from breathable 280 GSM premium combed cotton with an exaggerated drop-shoulder and wide boxy torso.
details: Laser raw-cut lower hem with lock-stitch unravel prevention
Distressed sleeve cuffs and vintage enzyme wash
Tonal embroidered DHAKAIYA mini chest insignia

title: Dhakaiya Dripz Heavy Denim Carpenter Utility Pants
tagline: 13.5 oz raw selvedge-feel washed denim with hammer loop details.
description: Heavy-duty 13.5 oz cotton denim washed down to a soft vintage hand feel. Features authentic workwear details including an authentic side hammer loop, double tool utility pockets, triple-needle contrast stitching, and heavy antique brass hardware.
details: Authentic left leg hammer loop & dual ruler pockets
Custom embossed Dhakaiya Dripz antique brass shank buttons
Relaxed straight cut with comfortable thigh room
